newsitem.title: FRANCE: Reuters French Advertising & Media Digest-July 15.
newsitem.headline: Reuters French Advertising & Media Digest-July 15.

text.p: News from Reuters and the French press on Advertising, Marketing, Media, the Internet and Brand-name Products.

PARIS - ART, the French telecommunications regulator, says telephone operator France Telecom must allow cable television companies to supply Internet connection on cable networks they operate which are owned by France Telecom. (Reuter)
PARIS - France Telecom may appeal against ART's decision on Internet access via cable networks. (Les Echos)

PARIS - The audience market share for French music radio station NRJ dipped in the April to June period, while market share at RTL, France's biggest general radio station, rose, according to figures from French audience measurement body Mediametrie. (Reuter)
BRUSSELS - New car registrations in western Europe soared nine percent in June to 1,135,600 units from June 1996, the European Automobile Manufacturers Association (ACEA) says.(Reuter)
PARIS - French luxury goods and drinks group LVMH Moet Hennessy Louis Vuitton says it is still working on a plan for a three-way merger with Guinness and Grand Met. (Reuter)
HANOI - French fashion house Pierre Cardin has taken a new partner to produce its shirts in Vietnam after sacking a state-owned firm for producing and selling fakes. (Reuter)
TOKYO - Inchcape Peugeot Japan Co Ltd, the Japanese import and distribution unit for Peugeot cars, says it aims at Japanese sales of 20,000 cars in the year 2000. (Reuter)
For further information and news, see Reuters Adverising & Media Briefing. And visit us on the Internet at http://www.Bizinfo.reuters.com
